# MMK Library

Digital archive of the Moscow Methodological Circle (MMK): works by G.P. Shchedrovitsky and his school.
207 full-text books in Markdown (OCR-extracted), 219 scanned originals in PDF and DJVU, 8 audio lectures.
Period: 1959–2014. Language: Russian. License: CC BY-SA 4.0.

Repository: https://github.com/soviet-methodology/MMK_Library
Author: Maxim Osovsky (https://www.linkedin.com/in/maximosovsky/)

## Key facts

- 207 Markdown files (full-text OCR from scans, ~16 MB) in md/
- 123 PDF scans (~1.4 GB) + 96 DJVU scans (~450 MB)
- 8 MP3 audio lectures (~360 MB)
- 196 HTML source captures from fondgp.ru (~240 MB)
- 204 book folders (one per work): author—title—year
- 85+ unique authors: Shchedrovitsky, Blauberg, Piskopel, Ladenko, Litvinov, etc.
- All texts post-processed: hyphen cleanup applied to OCR output

## Structure

MMK_Library/
├── md/                          # 207 full-text Markdown files
├── Блауберг И.Г. - .../        # 204 book folders, each = one work
│   ├── ...pdf
│   └── ...djvu
├── .gitignore
├── llms.txt
├── llms-full.txt
└── README.md

## How to use

```bash
git clone https://github.com/soviet-methodology/MMK_Library.git
cd MMK_Library
grep -r "мыследеятельность" md/     # Full-text search across all books
```

Read any book: open md/*.md. Verify wording against scans in corresponding book folders.
